rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=12, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=128, naf_layers=4, naf_n_iter=8000, naf_lr=0.01, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1150, naf_per_scene_s=90.0, naf_encoding=fourier, seed=42, rationale=iter-9 breast-ct-claude-agentic-naf-search-20260703-01 (redone breast split train3600/val200/test200 seed20260703; val_n=12 CONSTANT for iters 2-20 per coordinator budget intervention 2026-07-05 -- first-12 of the 200-case breast val split, deterministic). SIX-BOX: (1) prior result: all iters so far hr=0 (iter-1 val_n=20 ssim0.355 PSNR6.26 in 970s, NOT a timeout -- a genuine converged fit). (2) failure mode: NAF per-scene INR recon is far below the 128-view breast LD-FBP baseline. (3) ONE knob changed: per_scene 60->90 (deeper fit, in-budget). (4) hypothesis: iters 7-8 (TV sweep) hr=0. KNOB: raise per-scene fit budget 60->90s (12*90=1080s ~18min, in-budget) so each scene runs MORE Adam steps -> lower data-fit loss. HYPOTHESIS: if the hr=0 were step-starvation the deeper fit would lift it; it will not (loss floor is basis-limited). This isolates convergence from the basis ceiling for the fourier path. (5) wall: val_n=12 x per_scene 90.0s = ~1080s < 20min. (6) serial, no user return.
